name: Yulla Kanda
description: A quiet Kinnaur trail to the Yulla Kanda meadow, home to a Lord Krishna temple believed to be the highest of its kind. Apple orchards and cedar give way to open ridges with Kinner Kailash across the valley, and because Kinnaur sits in the rain shadow it walks well right through the monsoon.

name: Leh/Ladakh (7N/8D)
description: Ladakh is where high-altitude mountains, ancient monasteries, remote villages and endless roads come together. From the landscapes of Nubra and Pangong to the culture of Turtuk and the remote Changthang region, this journey takes you beyond the usual tourist route and into the raw side of the Himalayas.

name: Friendship Peak
description:
Friendship Peak Trek  is a challenging Himalayan summit expedition in Himachal Pradesh, taking you deep into the spectacular Pir Panjal range. Starting from the beautiful Solang Valley near Manali, the trail passes through lush forests, alpine meadows, rocky terrain, and high-altitude landscapes before reaching the snow-covered summit.

The trek combines scenic trekking with the thrill of a technical summit climb. As you gain altitude, the landscape transforms dramatically, offering breathtaking views of surrounding Himalayan peaks and valleys. The final summit push demands strong endurance, physical fitness, acclimatization, and the ability to handle challenging terrain and changing mountain conditions.

The experience is not just about reaching the summit, but about learning to move through high-altitude terrain, adapting to the mountains, and experiencing the raw beauty of the Himalayas.

**Best suited for:** Experienced trekkers and adventure seekers looking for a challenging Himalayan summit experience.

**Highlights:**
🏔️ High-altitude summit experience
❄️ Snow-covered Himalayan landscapes
🌲 Forests and alpine meadows
🥾 Challenging terrain and
short_description: Friendship Peak Trek is a thrilling Himalayan adventure in Himachal Pradesh, taking you through alpine meadows, dramatic mountain landscapes, and high-altitude terrain. A challenging climb for adventure seekers, it offers an exciting introduction to Himalayan summit experiences.

safety.rules:
Always stay with the trek group.
Follow the trek leader and safety instructions.
Do not attempt the summit or route independently.
Do not litter or damage the environment.
Respect local communities and wildlife.
Do not consume alcohol or recreational substances during the trek.
safety.medical:
Good physical fitness is essential.
Inform the trek leader about any existing medical conditions.
Carry prescribed medicines and a personal first-aid kit.
Consult a doctor before undertaking a high-altitude trek if required.
safety.weather:
Himalayan weather can change rapidly.
Snow, rain, strong winds and low temperatures may affect the itinerary.
Carry proper warm and waterproof clothing.
Follow the trek leader’s instructions regarding weather-related route changes.
safety.altitude:
Friendship Peak reaches approximately 5,289 m.
Altitude sickness can occur. Watch for headache, nausea, dizziness, unusual fatigue or breathing difficulty.
Stay hydrated and follow the trek leader’s acclimatization instructions.
Do not ignore or hide symptoms.
